(stop on breach; explain in the report)
⛔ Not in scope: the claim-template block of SKILL.md and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (#25115's region); `AGENTS.md`; any `scripts/**`; a coordinator reference (#25219 carries it, serial after this card).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:thread` (the maintainer's word: one project thread per M-or-larger card), `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` at `03de83b`: "MANDATORY: … clause ① of the model-tiering ruling (narrowed to protocol semantics, 2026-08-20)"), `effort: high` (M, p2). Governed surface `.claude/**` is Tier S: a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS record on the PR's head plus all-green checks, then the seat lands it.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card (a maintainer word not yet written into the skill)
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: #25185 (PR #25214) merged as `03de83bfe145eea8f495bcbc9886105715721b3f` before this claim; #25115 (claim-template block + os-dev.md) disjoint by region; #25219 (coordinator reference) is serial AFTER this card and not started. Re-check the open-PR list for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` before your first edit and name what you found.
